These two Minnesota fraudsters stole millions from Medicaid, a program that is meant to help Americans. 

Earlier this year, I warned Minnesota officials that the fraud must come to an end and that we will hold accountable those who ignored these scams for years. 

We are working for the taxpayers!

I have confidence that at the end of the day, President Trump will not agree to a bad deal with Iran.

This is madness. It is dangerous. And it must end NOW. 

No more victims because sanctuary jurisdictions refuse to cooperate with ICE.

Sanctuary Cities need to pay the price for protecting illegal alien criminals.

Organized, paid protesters in New Jersey, along with Antifa, tried to shut down an ICE facility that is holding rapists, murderers, child predators, and drug dealers – on Memorial Day. 

Enough is Enough.

What a judicial power grab.

If President Trump does that, they should change the name of the Nobel Prize to the Trump Prize.

If there’s anybody you want on your team in South Carolina, it’s President @realDonaldTrump and @RussellFrySC.

As of today, I’m honored to have both of their endorsements. 

A special thanks to my friends in Conway for your enthusiasm and support.

I’m grateful to have Congressman @RussellFrySC's support in this race.

Congressman Fry knows what it takes to deliver results, stand with President Trump, and fight for South Carolina values—and I’m proud to have him on our team.

The Republican primary is June 9. Make a plan to vote early or on Election Day, and let’s keep delivering for South Carolina.

Under Biden and Obama’s watch, Iran became rich and lethal. 

Billions of dollars went to the Ayatollah to build up their nuclear weapons program.

On President Trump’s watch, Iran became poor and weak. President Trump stopped Iran from getting a nuclear weapon.

Video

I’m honored to have President @realDonaldTrump’s complete and total endorsement.

On June 9th, voters will send a clear message: the people of South Carolina stand with President Trump.

Video

Ending day 1 of our Get Out the Vote tour in Easley, SC. 

Republicans are ready to stand united with President Trump and his agenda.

Congratulations to @schighwaypatrol Trooper R.A. Lee on being named 2026 National Trooper of the Year by the American Association of State Troopers. He is the first South Carolina Highway Patrol trooper to receive this award.
 
Lance Corporal Lee was recognized for stopping a speeding, stolen car that was traveling the wrong way on the interstate from Charlotte into South Carolina by using his own vehicle to stop the speeding car.
